tldr: Adds a Beacon Relay bounce webhook at service "beacon": answers the handshake, checks an optional shared secret, and maps delivery reports to hard, soft or complaint bounces. Adds settings, a v1.3.0 migration and UI. An empty secret means no auth.

reading_order.summary: Core: handshake, shared-secret check, event parsing, status-to-bounce-type mapping
Routes beacon by the X-Beacon-Event header: handshake vs delivery reports
New Opt fields and Manager.Beacon wiring
Reads bounce.beacon into Consts and the bounce Opt
Masks the shared secret on read, keeps it when blank on update
Default bounce.beacon settings row for fresh installs
Upserts the bounce.beacon settings row for existing installs
Beacon enable switch, secret and header inputs
Labels and help text for the Beacon settings
Setup instructions for the Beacon endpoint
Adds beacon to the webhook service enum
